title: A Confession for the Portrait
author: Wren Nakamura
blurb: Rafael Thornbury, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
